mnemonics.wars-vietnam: Hueys lift off a rooftop embassy while dominoes topple in the rice paddies below.
mnemonics.disasters-1906-sf: Picture a breakfast table cracking open at 5:12—eggs sliding, the city sliding, the whole scrambled world sliding into flame. One jolt, three days of fire, a skyline born from ashes.
mnemonics.inventions-lithography: Grease on stone: water runs off, ink jumps on, and a Bavarian mamma's laundry list changes art forever.
mnemonics.sports-1982-superbowl: Joe Cool in the pocket, Walsh's whiteboard blooming — the West Coast offense graduates in Pontiac.
mnemonics.sports-1986-worldcup: Picture Maradona in '86 — one divine fist, one painted foot, and Mexico's thin air handed Argentina the Cup.
mnemonics.philosophy-bodhisattva: Nirvana's feast is spread — and the bodhisattva, starving, refuses bread until every soul walks in. Stubborn. Sacred. I love them.
mnemonics.engineering-watermill: A river clenches a wooden jaw, grinding wheat into the muscle of empires. Flour remembers what the stone forgets.
mnemonics.crafts-eyeglasses: Florence, 1280 — a monk rolls glass, scripture sharpens, and Europe reads its own mind for the first time.

quizReactions.1:low:generic: Even demigods stumble, darling. Read it again, slowly this time—wisdom rewards the patient, not the panicked.
quizReactions.1:low:history: Clever guess, but the Nile didn't whisper its secrets to just anyone—try again, and this time, let Egypt speak.
quizReactions.1:low:sports: Hmph. I've watched Olympians sprint barefoot on scorching sand—you can do better than that. Try again, this time with the fire of a true competitor.
quizReactions.1:low:philosophy: Socrates once said wisdom begins in not-knowing—you're already there. Now the real work begins, and I promise it's the good kind.
quizReactions.1:low:crafts: You hesitating over crafts is forgivable—we all start as clumsy mortals before the hands learn their wisdom. Pick up a chisel again, and this time let the wood speak first.
